messages:
tina: Heads up, new user opened a ticket: followed the quickstart (node sample) and the CLI printed 'Request succeeded' but no generated text. They attached stdout and said dashboard shows a small token usage.

omar: do we have the sample app logs? which sdk version?

tina: sample stdout:
```
$ node examples/hello.js --key sk-xxxx
calling model=open-7b
Request succeeded
Done
```
SDK: node-sdk 1.3.9 (sample from docs).

omar: that 'Request succeeded' without content smells like the SDK treated a 200-ish gate response as success. Can you get the raw curl or headers?

tina: user shared curl and body (sanitized):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
content-length: 150

{"id":"r_9","status":"partial","detail":"billing_preview_only","message":"Preview only: accept billing to generate","streaming":false}
```
Connection closed after body.

omar: our contract used to return 402 for billing gating, but infra rolled out a preview-mode response that returns 200 with detail 'billing_preview_only' for some trial orgs. Node SDK streaming path only looks for chunked events and final newline; seeing a single JSON then close can be misinterpreted as no data.

tina: user is worried about being billed because dashboard showed a token count. billing-bot: clarify whether previews count as usage.

billing-bot: Previews are recorded as 'preview footprint' for quota but are not invoiced until billing is accepted. However some dashboard endpoints aggregate attempts and can look like usage. We'll add a tooltip.

omar: action items: 1) SDK: treat 'detail' values like 'billing_preview_only' and 'billing_ack_required' as terminal errors if streaming=false; emit a clear exception. 2) infra: prefer 402 for gating or add header X-Gating-Reason so SDKs can recognize. 3) docs: onboarding note about "first call may be preview-gated".

tina: I'll file tickets and send the customer a workaround: accept billing invite or create a billing-enabled dev workspace.

omar: I'll PR node-sdk@1.3.10 to detect these sentinel responses and throw a clear error with message directing to the onboarding FAQ. Also change retry middleware to not retry on these responses.

sdk-bot: Release note: node-sdk@1.3.10 published (patch) - handles billing preview sentinel, avoids retrying on gated responses.

tina: user accepted billing invite and retried; streaming text returned as expected. Closing after docs blurb is up.

omar: followup: add test harness that simulates 200-with-gating-body and ensures client surfaces an error rather than silent success. Ticket DX-8802.

tina: thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
